_doc: Watch list for scripts/venue_drift.py: each target is a FREE read of one venue's own machine-readable contract. 'keep' (json) or 'between' (text) selects the load-bearing part — inputs, caps, enums, prices — and leaves live latency and success counts out, so only a contract change reads as drift. 'venues' names the VENUES.md row to reconcile on a DRIFT. kie and the Higgsfield API publish no machine-readable contract we read; their rows are checked by the first receipt after a change.
